# Hearscape: Sound Locator / 聲跡 Hearscape－噪音分貝計

> Hearscape turns your phone into a sound radar and noise log.

聲跡把手機變成聲音雷達和噪音紀錄器。

- iOS 18.0+ · v1.0.1 · 2026-11-25 · 8.6 MB
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6836749497?pt=102436810&ct=llms_hearscape&mt=8)
- [Support](https://agentmesh.uk/hearscape/support.html)

## FAQ

### How can I find which direction a noise comes from?
Open the Radar in Hearscape and turn slowly in a full circle: it paints a 360° heat ring and marks the loudest direction, with separate bearings for low, mid and high sounds. A phone held still cannot tell direction; turning finds it.

### 怎麼找出噪音從哪個方向來？
打開聲跡 Hearscape 的雷達，拿著手機慢慢轉一圈，它會畫出 360° 熱度環並標出最響的方向；低音、中音、高音也各自標出方向。手機拿著不動分不出方向，轉身掃描才找得到。

### Can I log noise overnight?
Yes. Hearscape keeps monitoring with the screen locked and records the night's decibel curve; when a threshold you set is passed it keeps a clip starting 5 seconds earlier, and you can export a PDF report. It measures with the phone's microphone and is not a certified sound level meter.

### 可以整夜記錄樓上或外面的噪音嗎？
可以。聲跡 Hearscape 鎖上螢幕也能持續監測，記下整夜的分貝曲線；門檻依環境部〈噪音管制標準〉設定，也可自訂，超過門檻時會從前 5 秒開始錄下片段，並可匯出 PDF 報告。這是手機麥克風量測，僅供參考，不是經檢定的噪音計。

### Can a phone work as a decibel meter, and how accurate is it?
Hearscape measures with the phone's microphone, with A, C and Z weighting, fast or slow response, Leq, Lmax, Lmin, L10 and L90, and a custom calibration offset. Readings are for reference only; it is not a certified sound level meter.

### 手機可以當分貝計用嗎？準不準？
聲跡用手機麥克風量測，提供 A、C、Z 加權與快／慢反應，並顯示 Leq、Lmax、Lmin、L10、L90，也可自訂校正值。量測結果僅供參考，並非經檢定的噪音計。

### Can I export my noise log as a report?
Yes. Hearscape exports a PDF report with a timeline, each period's Leq against the limit and every event; each recorded clip can be played and shared.

### 噪音紀錄可以匯出成報告嗎？
可以。聲跡能匯出 PDF 報告，包含時間軸、各時段 Leq 對照管制值，以及每一筆事件；每個錄下的片段也能播放與分享。

### Does Hearscape upload my recordings?
No. Recordings and logs stay on the phone, no account is needed, and no audio is uploaded.

### 聲跡的錄音會上傳到網路嗎？
不會。錄音和紀錄都存在這支手機上，不需要帳號，聲音不會上傳。

### Can I check decibels on Apple Watch?
Yes. Hearscape's Apple Watch app shows the live level, starts or stops overnight monitoring and taps your wrist when the threshold is crossed; a complication shows the monitoring state and the number of events.

### 可以用 Apple Watch 看分貝嗎？
可以。聲跡的 Apple Watch App 能在手腕上看即時分貝、開始或停止整夜監測，超過門檻時手錶會輕點提醒；錶面複雜功能也會顯示監測狀態與超標次數。
